tokens.name: color-cream
tokens.usage: Page background (body). Ground for ink, ink-soft, honey-600 text.

tokens.name: color-cream-2
tokens.usage: Raised ground: accordion toggle disc, soft bands between sections.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, chips, accordion items. Ground for ink, ink-soft and muted text.

tokens.name: color-surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover state of light buttons and nested panels inside a card.

tokens.name: color-panel
tokens.usage: Deep panels: footer and recessed blocks.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on cream, cream-2, surface, surface-2 (≥14.8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: color-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, labels, accordion answers, on cream and surface.

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: helper lines, captions, placeholders. Light theme measures 4.1:1 on cream and 4.4:1 on surface — just under 4.5:1 for small text; kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards, inputs, chips and dividers (gold in dark, red in light).

tokens.name: color-honey
tokens.usage: Metallic gold — the single CTA accent: primary fills, active chips, checked boxes, open accordion disc. Fill only; as text it is 2.4:1 on light surface.

tokens.name: color-honey-600
tokens.usage: Text accent and focus ring: eyebrows, accent words, links' hover. Light gold in dark, brand red in light theme.

tokens.name: color-honey-100
tokens.usage: Gold-tinted backing behind badges and highlighted rows.

tokens.name: color-onaccent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on honey and the gold gradient (9.5:1 dark, 7.2:1 light).

tokens.name: color-berry
tokens.usage: Berry red: sale tags, hearts, warnings. Text-safe on surface in both themes (5.2:1).

tokens.name: color-graphite
tokens.usage: Dark blocks (on-dark sections); wine red in the light theme. White text on it.

tokens.name: color-graphite-2
tokens.usage: Cards inside graphite blocks.

tokens.name: color-max
tokens.usage: MAX messenger button fill, white text (5.5:1). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: color-max-600
tokens.usage: MAX button hover.

tokens.name: color-tg
tokens.usage: Telegram button fill with white text — 3.0:1, below 4.5:1 for 15px text; kept as the source has it. Outline variant uses #1477a8 text.

tokens.name: color-leaf
tokens.usage: Green accent: freshness notes, ‘in stock’ ticks, on surface.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Plates over photos and the dark button fill (with honey-600 text).

tokens.name: color-bar
tokens.usage: Seasonal announcement bar background.

tokens.name: color-bar-fg

tokens.name: color-bar-link
tokens.usage: Link inside the seasonal bar, on bar.

tokens.name: color-river
tokens.usage: Delivery-map river and the river note chip.

tokens.name: color-river-fg

spacing.note: Layout runs on Tailwind v4's default 4px spacing unit (p-4 = 16px). Steps below are the ones the site uses most.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Tailwind base unit; every p-/m-/gap- step is a multiple.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips (gap-2).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between messenger buttons, checkbox and its text (gap-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Container side padding on phones; input and chip inner padding (px-4).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Accordion padding on phones (px-5 py-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button md padding (px-6); accordion padding from md.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Container side padding from md; button lg padding; section title margin on phones (mb-8).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section title bottom margin from md (md:mb-12).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Checkbox box (Tailwind default rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Small cards, photo thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Inputs, accordion items, notices — the standard card corner.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Large product cards, dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Every button, chip and pill — the site has no square buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards and the open accordion item.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dialogs, cookie notice: lift with a faint gold halo.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: Primary gold button glow (from Button primary).

tokens.name: shadow-cta-hover
tokens.usage: Primary gold button glow on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-max
tokens.usage: MAX button glow.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of .container-x, the page column.

tokens.name: header-offset
tokens.usage: scroll-padding-top under the sticky header.

tokens.name: mobile-bar-offset
tokens.usage: Body bottom padding on phones for the sticky order bar (plus safe area).
